Our Design Process

  1. 01

    Consultation

    We visit your home, discuss your needs, and measure the space.

  2. 02

    3D Design

    Our designers create photorealistic 3D visualisations of your walk-in.

  3. 03

    Specification

    You choose finishes, accessories, lighting, and layout details.

  4. 04

    Manufacturing

    Hand-crafted in our UK workshop using premium materials (3–4 weeks).

  5. 05

    Installation

    Professional fitting by our experienced team (typically 2–3 days).
